The '''B-NK Series Subversion Droid''' was an [[espionage droid]] model produced by [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]], a freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Manufactured in the Shroud's factory on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the B-NK Series appeared to be an ordinary [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], but possessed hidden [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]], [[Missile/Legends|missile]] launchers, and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. [[B-NK1]], one of the Shroud's lieutenants, was a B-NK Series, and the Shroud planned to disseminate the B-NK droids throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Deactivated B-NK Series Subversion Droids appear on assembly lines in the final [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] mission&mdash;"The Shroud Revealed" for Republic players and "All the Pieces" for Imperials&mdash; in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], the first Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. B-NK1 appears in earlier missions in the macrobinoculars line as well.<ref name="TOR" />
